The security-related and file-reading runtime exceptions indicate unrecoverable conditions (e.g., security manager restrictions, critical resource failure), and it is reasonable to let them propagate to the caller. The existing exception handling strategy is consistent with the design intent of converting checked `IOException` into runtime exceptions while leaving other runtime exceptions uncaught. Therefore, no optimization is necessary.
